findings.where: hero secondary CTA "Read the docs", 1440 tile 0
findings.evidence: dom-1440.json: Read the docs scrolls to the "Why Relay" feature cards, not to documentation; the nav's "Docs" link goes to #docs (the YAML section). The label promises one destination and delivers another.
findings.after: href="/docs" (the real documentation URL), or relabel to "See the config" with href="#docs"
findings.why: WCAG 2.2 2.4.4 Link Purpose (In Context): the accessible name must describe where the link goes. Nearest curated card A11-006.

findings.where: nav "Get started", all pricing buttons, CTA band, 7 footer links
findings.evidence: 13 of 20 links have href="#": "Get started", "Start free" (pricing), "Start 14-day trial", "Contact sales", "Get started free", "Changelog", "Documentation", "API reference", "Status", "About", "Blog", "Contact", and the logo. Activating them jumps to the top of the page.
findings.after: Real URLs for each (e.g. href="/signup?plan=team"); remove footer links whose pages do not exist
findings.why: WCAG 2.2 2.4.4 Link Purpose and 2.1.1 Keyboard: a keyboard or screen-reader user follows a named link and is moved to the page top with no explanation; for them the primary actions do not work.

findings.evidence: Decorative glyphs are plain text in the DOM with no aria-hidden recorded: icon divs "⌁", "◉", "↻" and terminal markers "$", "→" x4, "✓". A screen reader announces e.g. "fisheye, Full observability" and "right arrow, plan dot 4 steps dot ...".
findings.after:
◉
; same for the terminal's $, → and ✓ spans; give the terminal panel role="img" aria-label="Example run: 4 steps, one retry, done in 2 minutes 14 seconds for $0.61" or mark it aria-hidden if purely decorative
findings.why: WCAG 2.2 1.1.1 Non-text Content: decorative symbols must be hidden from assistive tech; meaningful ones need a text alternative.

findings.evidence: All 20 stops use the browser default ring (outline auto 1px rgb(16,16,16)) with no :focus-visible style. focus/01-on.png and 05-on.png show a thin two-tone ring that is visible but low-weight against the translucent glass and the purple aurora; on the light "Start free" pill the ring sits on a dark shadow edge.
findings.after: :focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #fff; outline-offset: 3px; } and for light pills outline-color: #a5b4fc
findings.why: WCAG 2.2 2.4.7 Focus Visible and 2.4.13 Focus Appearance (AAA guidance): a designed 2px ring at 3:1 against both adjacent colours is needed over a varying gradient ground.

findings.evidence: focus.json: the first stop is the logo link "R Relay"; there is no skip link before the 5-item nav.
findings.after: Skip to content as the first child of body, and wrap header-to-CTA content in
findings.why: WCAG 2.2 2.4.1 Bypass Blocks; pairs with the sweep's missing <main> hit.

findings.where: pricing tier names and meta lines, 1440 tile 3
findings.evidence: "STARTER", "TEAM", "ENTERPRISE" and "forever · 100 runs/mo", "per month · unlimited" are 12-13px text at rgba(255,255,255,0.5) on translucent glass over a moving-colour ground; the contrast varies with what sits behind each card, so the 10th-percentile sample understates the risk where the cyan or magenta orb passes behind.
findings.after: --text-subtle: rgba(255,255,255,0.78) and an opaque card fill (e.g. #2a2550) so text contrast no longer depends on the orbs
findings.why: WCAG 2.2 1.4.3 Contrast (Minimum): text over blurred, translucent layers must meet 4.5:1 at its worst point, not on average.

strengths: Heading outline is mostly sound: one h1, an h2 per section, h3 per feature.
All content remains visible with reduced motion, scripts off and observers blocked (hidden.json).
Pricing tiers state their limits in text rather than colour or icons alone.
not_investigated: disputed: sweep focus_ring Floor hits on "Relay" and "Changelog" (covered by a fixed element). focus/00-on.png and 13-on.png show both fully visible with their ring; the logo is inside the fixed nav itself and the footer link is not under it at that scroll position.
Whether the glyph spans carry aria-hidden: dom-1440.json does not record aria-hidden, so finding 3 should be confirmed in source.
Keyboard operation: no menus, dialogs or tabs on the page; no live Playwright run.
Reflow at 320 and the 1.4.12 text-spacing override were not run beyond the 375 tiles.
